La operadora le pide que no deje solo a Nicolás y que, si empeora, vuelva a llamar de inmediato.
Daniel le explica a la guía lo que pasó y le pide ayuda: Esperanza, espere a los bomberos en la entrada, por favor.
Esperanza corre a la entrada de la finca y guía a los bomberos hasta el cafetal.
Daniel: Nicolás, quédate conmigo; ya vienen los bomberos.
Un bombero revisa el brazo, no encuentra ningún aguijón y sube a Nicolás a la camilla para llevarlo a la clínica.
En la recepción, Aurora abre el expediente de Nicolás y pregunta la hora del incidente.
Daniel: Le picó una avispa a las 10:30, en el cafetal.
Aurora explica que la clínica cobra en quetzales y que necesita una garantía de pago de la aseguradora.
Después, Daniel llama a la aseguradora de viaje y le pregunta a la agente: Si la clínica necesita la garantía de pago, ¿se la mandan directamente?
La agente responde que sí y le pide que guarde todos los recibos de la clínica.
Por la tarde, Nicolás da su consentimiento para que Daniel le escriba a su hermana Valeria.
Daniel: Hola, Valeria, Nicolás me pidió que te escribiera: está estable.
Por la noche, Daniel revisa la cronología con Esperanza antes de escribir el resumen del día para la aseguradora.
Daniel escribe: A continuación, resumo lo ocurrido durante el tour de hoy.
Al final, Daniel explica que la aseguradora necesita los documentos y escribe: Por lo tanto, adjunto el expediente y los recibos en quetzales.
native: At 10:30, in the coffee field of a farm near Antigua Guatemala, a wasp stings Nicolás on the arm.
A few minutes later, Nicolás's face is red, and his friend Daniel immediately calls the firefighters.
Daniel: My friend has swollen lips and is having trouble breathing.
The operator asks him not to leave Nicolás alone and, if he gets worse, to call again immediately.
Daniel explains to the guide what happened and asks for help: Esperanza, please wait for the firefighters at the entrance.
Esperanza runs to the farm entrance and guides the firefighters to the coffee field.
Daniel: Nicolás, stay with me; the firefighters are on their way.
A firefighter checks the arm, finds no stinger and puts Nicolás on the stretcher to take him to the clinic.
At the reception desk, Aurora opens Nicolás's patient file and asks for the time of the incident.
Daniel: A wasp stung him at 10:30, in the coffee field.
Aurora explains that the clinic charges in quetzales and that it needs a guarantee of payment from the insurer.
Next, Daniel calls the travel insurer and asks the agent: If the clinic needs the guarantee of payment, will you send it directly?
The agent says yes and asks him to keep all the receipts from the clinic.
In the afternoon, Nicolás gives his consent for Daniel to write to his sister Valeria.
Daniel: Hi, Valeria, Nicolás asked me to write to you: he's stable.
In the evening, Daniel goes over the timeline with Esperanza before writing the day's summary for the insurer.
Daniel writes: Below, I summarize what happened during today's tour.
At the end, Daniel explains that the insurer needs the documents and writes: Therefore, I am attaching the patient file and the receipts in quetzales.

example.target: Si una avispa te pica, avísale a la guía.
example.native: If a wasp stings you, tell the guide.

verbs.note: Used with an indirect object for the person: le pica a Nicolás. Past: le picó.

example.target: Daniel llama de inmediato a los bomberos.
example.native: Daniel immediately calls the firefighters.

verbs.note: Use the personal a before people: llamar a los bomberos.

example.target: Esperanza, espere a los bomberos en la entrada, por favor.
example.native: Esperanza, please wait for the firefighters at the entrance.

verbs.note: No preposition needed for 'wait for'. Formal usted command: espere.

example.target: Nicolás, quédate conmigo.
example.native: Nicolás, stay with me.

verbs.note: Informal tú command: quédate; formal usted command: quédese.

example.target: Daniel escribe el resumen del día para la aseguradora.
example.native: Daniel writes the day's summary for the insurer.

verbs.note: Regular -ir verb. Use escribirle a alguien for writing to a person.
